name: presence
title: Room presence
about: A presence sensor (mmWave radar, Wi-Fi sensing or a PIR) reports, twice a second, whether a room is empty, holds someone still, or someone moving, with the features a model would learn from.

fields.name: state
fields.about: what the sensor's own logic decided

fields.name: confidence_pct
fields.about: the sensor's confidence in that state

fields.name: range_cm
fields.about: distance to the nearest target, 0 if none

fields.name: motion_energy
fields.about: summed Doppler energy, larger for bigger movement

fields.name: still_energy
fields.about: energy at zero Doppler near the target (breathing, small motion)

headline: state
people
range_cm

label.source: a person's tag, a door switch, or a simulator; the sensor's own state is not the truth

training.note: rate_hz is what the hub logs (about 1 sample a second over advertising), not what the sensor sends
